crops.text: (WOF) All other friendly creatures gain 1 Marked For Life that cannot stack higher than 1.Friendly prime creatures gain the following ability:(1PG)(Action) Give star level # - 1 Special Attention counters to the granter of this ability, which are immediately spent to gain 1 stat bar of choice each.(1CD)(4 points) Inflict a creature with 1T2 Hyper and increase its star level by 1, but not higher than 4.
